data.name: Hedi
data.gender_notes: Hedi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hadiya', meaning 'gift' or 'present'. Hedi represents contentment and satisfaction in life. This name is perfect for a baby girl who is believed to bring joy and happiness to her family. The name Hedi carries the meaning “Contentment, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Hedi usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, Hedi symbolizes the inner peace and tranquility that comes from being content with one's life and surroundings. This name is a reminder to focus on the present moment and find joy in the simple things.
data.etymology: Hedi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment, Satisfaction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hedi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: هدي

in_urdu.name: ہدی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہدی ایک عربی نام ہے جو کہ اللہ کی عطا کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے، کیونکہ یہ شکر گزاری کا اظہار کرتا ہے جو کہ ایک بنیادی اسلامی فضیلت ہے

in_hindi.name: हेदी

in_pashto.name: هېدي
